text:
marcos: Heads-up: external assessor (SecProbe) confirmed a focused pen test against staging next Thu. We need to lock down RBAC window, KMS access pattern, evidence uploads, and retest booking. looping @anya @kevin @nisha
anya: Prefer a short 2h window, staging-only. Ephemeral SSO role is a must. No service account tokens.
kevin: I'll create `pt_assessor_session` with condition on aws:SourceIp and aws:RequestedDurationSeconds=7200. KMS: we'll allow GenerateDataKey + Decrypt on the dedicated PT key. Sample KMS snippet for vendor review:
```
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:Decrypt"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/pt-2026-zzzz"
}
```
anya: For evidence: presigned PUTs into `s3://pt-ingest/{eng-id}/incoming/`. Require `x-amz-meta-sha256` and content-type. No multipart. Max file 200MB. Provide curl example for vendor: 
```
curl -H "x-amz-meta-sha256: <sha256>" -T report.json "<presigned-url>"
```
marcos: Enable S3 ObjectLock (GOVERNANCE) for 21d on the locked prefix and enforce server-side tags `pt-id` and `engagement`.
nisha: Audit: enable CloudTrail data events for the ingest prefix and push to Splunk/Chronicle. Tag all events with `pt_id`. Retain 395 days. Also add an entry to the compliance runbook about immediate key rotation after the window.
evidence-bot: [INFO] Presign service must emit JSON logs: {"svc":"presign","pt_id":"<id>","uploader":"vendor","result":"success|fail"} -> forward to /pt-logs for SIEM.
kevin: I'll wire a webhook so vendor can POST findings into vuln-tracker as `PT Intake` cards. We still triage internally before opening remediation tickets. Suggested SLA: ack 24h, remediation plan 3 business days for critical.
marcos: Action owners / due EOD:
- kevin: create role + KMS policy + export session policy for vendor
- anya: confirm final window and hands-off runbook
- nisha: enable CloudTrail data events + SIEM forward + retention
- infra: enable ObjectLock + presign constraints (I'll ping infra)
pd-bot: [BOT] PagerDuty stub PD-PT-2026-300 created for test window.
kevin: ack
anya: ack
nisha: ack
marcos: Closing thread unless vendor asks for HSM or longer retention. Will reopen if anything changes. Thanks all!
